scientific_integrity: The theorem is analytically proved under explicit sufficient contraction assumptions; finite checks are corroborative and independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: No necessary threshold for the contraction region; no classification for c*d*d >= b. Nonexistence of invariant measures in discontinuous maps and ghost-orbit phenomena predate this specific parameter theorem.
title: An attracting two-cycle disappears into a nonstationary ghost at a discontinuity
